newsitem.title: FRANCE: Two bomb blasts in Corsica - French police.
newsitem.headline: Two bomb blasts in Corsica - French police.

text.p: Separate bomb blasts damaged an automobile showroom and a parked car on the turbulent Mediterranean island of Corsica overnight but there were no casualties, French police said on Sunday.

There was no immediate indication if the attacks were the work of local gangsters or of Corsican separatists seeking more autonomy from France. Both use identical methods and police believe many of the same people are involved.
The blasts came hours after a suspected leader of the outlawed Corsican National Liberation Front (FLNC) was jailed and placed under investigation in Paris.

Justice sources said Jean-Michel Rossi, a leading member of A Cuncolta Naziunalista, the political arm of the FLNC, was being investigated for suspected membership of a terrorist group and offences against weapons laws.
